text.p: A large bullish trade in options in Ladbroke Plc was among the standout features among equity options on Friday, dealers said.
Market experts noted a large buyer of February 220 calls in Ladbroke, with 2,430 contracts traded. Ladbroke shares were up 5p at 207-1/2 by 1526 GMT.
Some 500 lots of the May 220 calls in Ladbroke were also dealt.
Elsehwere British Gas continued to be active after this week's outbreak of bid speculation, with 541 contracts of the March 240 calls traded along with 312 March 220 puts.
In FTSE 100 index options, there was continued activity in out-of-the-money puts including 2,000 lots of the European-style December 3,625 contract.
Among the calls some 3,608 lots of the December 4,125 contract were traded. The FTSE 100 was up 53.9 points at 4,007.7, after breaking through the 4,000 barrier for the first time this month.
